body.x: Orfeo SoundWorks introduced a new concept Earphone Mars at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' held in Las Vegas on January 7th (Sunday).

Orefeo SoundWorks is an engineering-driven research and development company founded in 2015 to enhance the listening experience for everyone in the globe. They produce Bluetooth earphones for the general consumers, and specialized headsets for the communication, automobile, distribution and aircraft companies by ODM. Recently, as the rapid growth of IoT market launched new products with a voice recognition control system, not with a screen touch system previously.

Mars, introduced at CES 2018 Unveiled, has jointly been developed with Naver Line and equipped with real-time automatic interpretation function. In communication with different language speakers, the language was interpreted immediately by the earphones and can be heard with an interpreted language. You can enjoy communications fluently with Mars without additional devices.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
